component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.timer = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.5 m.timer.observeField("fire", "openGallery") m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub openGallery() m.body = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbeGallery") m.body.id = "body" m.top.appendChild(m.body) print "PROBE|open: body.setFocus" m.body.setFocus(true) print "PROBE|open: focusFirstCell" m.body.callFunc("focusFirstCell") dump("open") print "PROBE|0|MANUAL|keys" end sub
sub dump(label as string) line = "PROBE|state " + label for each id in ["h0", "h1", "h2", "v0", "v1", "v2"] line = line + " " + id + "=" + m.top.findNode(id).hasFocus().toStr() end for print line end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press then dump("after-" + key) return false end function
